pages.lesson:
LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 9.3.1 WORD CLASS: ADVERBS

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 9
Topic 9.3: Grammar in Use 9.3.1 Word Class: Adverbs

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Grammar in Use 9.3.1 Word Class: Adverbs. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How do we describe when, how, where and how many times an action takes place?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify adverbs of manner, time, place and frequency in a text
2. use adverbs correctly in oral and written contexts
3. use the modals could and would and the phrase how many...could/would in sentences correctly

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify adverbs of manner, time, place and frequency in a text
   In simple words: practise until you can identify adverbs of manner, time, place and frequency in a text. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. use adverbs correctly in oral and written contexts
   In simple words: practise until you can use adverbs correctly in oral and written contexts. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. use the modals could and would and the phrase how many...could/would in sentences correctly
   In simple words: practise until you can use the modals could and would and the phrase how many...could/would in sentences correctly. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Grammar in Use 9.3.1 Word Class: Adverbs using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Grammar in Use 9.3.1 Word Class: Adverbs in the examples.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 9.3.1 Word Class: Adverbs to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Grammar in Use 9.3.1 Word Class: Adverbs.
4. Show that you can: identify adverbs of manner, time, place and frequency in a text

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 9.3.1 Word Class: Adverbs using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in Use 9.3.1 Word Class: Adverbs important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Identify and list adverbs from a digital or print text collaboratively,
2. Make sentences from a substitution table using the pattern how many...could/would,
3. Construct sentences using adverbs of manner, time place and frequency,
4. Self-efficacy is enhanced as the learner recites poems containing adverbs and creates a crossword puzzle using different types of adverbs individually.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do we describe when, how, where and how many times an action takes place?
2. Which word or words do we use to ask questions?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify adverbs of manner, time, place and frequency in a text
2. use adverbs correctly in oral and written contexts
3. use the modals could and would and the phrase how many...could/would in sentences correctly

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
